results.content: Civiqs has been tracking this since the day Trump took the oath, and as of late July, Trump’s net approval in Texas sits at -13. Texas is one of eleven states Trump carried by double digits in 2024 where he’s now underwater, in the “should have been safe but isn’t” column. [...] Now, before anybody gets too excited about the “Hispanic realignment reversal is here,” I want to point out something. TX34 has the smallest swing of the three, thirteen points, and it’s not because the voters there care less about Trump. It’s the candidates. Look at the favorability numbers underneath these races.
